name: Onna Kaizoku ~Na○ & Ro○n~
source:
They ruled the high seas. Now the beautiful pirates are helpless prisoners of a damp, dark jail. Each thinking of the other, they endure whatever's coming. Even in captivity the ladies are sailing boundless seas: a world of undiscovered pleasure! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE165440.html]DLsite English[/url]]
